checks.reason: Added on the coordinator's follow-up. South Cerney is the Army's Duke of Gloucester Barracks, and RAF Brize Norton publishes it as the 'South Cerney Drop Zone' for scheduled military local training sorties (November 2026 schedule). The resident team, the RLC Silver Stars, is an Army display team for Regular and Reserve RLC personnel. A stakeholder response in a CAA airspace-change consultation says resident parachuting no longer takes place and any activity is rare and NOTAM-covered. British Skydiving lists no club here, though it does list military clubs that take civilians elsewhere (APA Netheravon, RAFSPA Weston-on-the-Green). The only civilian jumping found is a 2008 Red Devils / Click and Jump tandem day, so I treat it as a military-only drop zone. The main risk is that this partly rests on absence: I found no explicit 'military only' statement, only no civilian route.
